name: Living Holy
overview: Living holy involves a sincere turning from sin, as God desires His people to confess and forsake their iniquities rather than conceal them, promising mercy to those who do so. True purity of heart brings the blessing of seeing God, a state made possible by being cleansed through the Word of Christ. This holy living aligns with God's good plans for His people, who are called to experience His peace and restoration rather than judgment.
